decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 0.9584. Series context: trend strength 0.9912 and seasonal strength 0.5825; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.119); 11 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.669.
